summary: Provides precise control of vertical motion throughout approximately ½” range.
specs: Generally used for fine vertical positioning after the instrument height has been roughly established with a stand column.
Large diameter, fine-motion screw allows minute height adjustments of previously leveled instruments
Recessed dovetail socket allows mounting of slides or other configured products on top, with socket head set screws to hold them in place.
